[[File:Azgoghk_stern.jpg|thumb|right|250px|An Imperial dungeon ship]]
'''Prison ships''',<ref name="GMHB">''[[Star Wars Campaign Pack]]''</ref> also known as '''dungeon ships''', '''prison barges''', or '''detention barges''',<ref name="SD">{{JournalCite|9|Slaying Dragons}}</ref> were [[Starship/Legends|starships]] used for transport and interrogation of prisoners. They were used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protectors]], and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
